d: Today we find out if the Pixel 11 Pro XL 'anti scratch' coating actually works. Get your own device some protection with dbrands Grip case and Prism Screen Protector here: Taking apart the Pixel 11 Pro XL is actually pretty easy. Google has designed their phones to be pretty repairable. Yeah - you'll still need a heatgun and a really thin pry tool to get the front screen or back glass off - but once thats gone - the Pixel 11 Pro is again probably one of the most repairable smartphones of the year.
